page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.2-8 is a compute-focused virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 4 virtual CPUs derived from 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6354 processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.0 GHz, supporting two threads per core. The instance is configured with dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent compute execution without core oversubscription. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for compute-bound operations that require modest per-thread memory capacity.

The instance does not incorporate bundled local storage, necessitating reliance on network-attached block volumes for persistent data retention and filesystem hosting. It also excludes hardware accelerators, operating with zero dedicated GPUs. Network provisioning includes a single complimentary public IPv4 address for external ingress and egress. Because memory is limited relative to the core count, memory-intensive datasets must be structured carefully to prevent paging to remote block storage.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, VM.Optimized3.Flex.2-8 balances dedicated Xeon compute performance against a streamlined memory footprint, minimizing resource overhead for tasks that do not require extensive RAM. The instance profile is aligned with CPU-centric tasks such as continuous integration build agents, batch processing scripts, lightweight distributed compilation, and microservice-based web serving.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.2-8 is an x86_64 compute-oriented virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon 6354 processor running at 3.0 GHz. The configuration allocates 4 dedicated virtual CPUs across 2 physical cores, accompanied by 8.0 GB of system memory, creating a compact 2.0 GB per vCPU profile. The instance includes no local disk storage, requiring external block storage for operating system images and persistent data, and features no dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported with one complimentary public IPv4 address. With dedicated CPU allocation and a low memory-to-vCPU ratio, VM.Optimized3.Flex.2-8 offers predictable compute execution and operational cost efficiency for workloads that demand steady processor throughput without large memory footprints. Best-fit use cases include automated software compilation, stateless application tiers, continuous integration pipelines, and general batch processing tasks.
